Benchmark Survival Learners (Meta Function)

Source: R/benchmark_default_survlearners.R
benchmark.Rd

The single entry point for comparing multiple survival learners. With tune = FALSE (default), each learner is run with fixed hyperparameters via benchmark_default_survlearners. With tune = TRUE, each learner is tuned internally per outer fold via nested cross-validation using benchmark_tuned_survlearners.

Usage

benchmark(
  formula,
  data,
  learners,
  times,
  metrics = c("cindex", "ibs"),
  tune = FALSE,
  folds = 5,
  outer_folds = 5,
  inner_folds = 5,
  seed = 123,
  ncores = 1,
  inner_ncores = 1,
  learner_args = list(),
  refit_final = FALSE,
  verbose = FALSE,
  suppress_errors = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

A survival formula of the form Surv(time, status) ~ x1 + x2 + ....

data

A data frame containing the variables in formula.

learners

Character vector of learner ids (without prefixes), e.g. c("ranger", "coxph", "glmnet").

times

Numeric vector of evaluation time points for survival predictions.

metrics

Character vector of metrics to compute/optimize.

tune

Logical; if FALSE (default), benchmarks learners with fixed hyperparameters (folds, ncores apply). If TRUE, tunes each learner via nested CV (outer_folds, inner_folds, inner_ncores, learner_args, refit_final apply).

folds

Integer number of CV folds; used only when tune = FALSE.

outer_folds, inner_folds

Integer numbers of outer/inner CV folds; used only when tune = TRUE.

seed

Integer random seed.

ncores

Integer CPU cores for fold-level mapping; used only when tune = FALSE.

inner_ncores

Integer CPU cores for each learner's inner tuning CV; used only when tune = TRUE.

learner_args

Optional named list of learner-specific tuning arguments; used only when tune = TRUE. See benchmark_tuned_survlearners.

refit_final

Logical; if TRUE (and tune = TRUE), tunes and refits each learner on the full dataset in addition to the outer CV.

verbose

Logical; print progress.

suppress_errors

Logical; if TRUE (default), per-learner errors are caught and reported via warning() instead of stopping the whole benchmark.

...

Additional arguments forwarded to benchmark_default_survlearners() (fit arguments) when tune = FALSE, or to benchmark_tuned_survlearners() (common tuning arguments) when tune = TRUE.

Value

With tune = FALSE, a data frame of CV results (see benchmark_default_survlearners). With tune = TRUE, a list of class "nested_surv_benchmark" (see benchmark_tuned_survlearners).

See also

benchmark_default_survlearners(), benchmark_tuned_survlearners()

Examples

# \donttest{
res <- benchmark(
  Surv(time, status) ~ age + karno + trt,
  data = veteran,
  learners = c("coxph", "rpart"),
  times = c(80, 160),
  metrics = c("cindex", "ibs"),
  folds = 2,
  seed = 1
)
head(res)
#>         splits    id fold metric value learner
#> 1 list(trt.... Fold1    1 cindex 0.694   coxph
#> 2 list(trt.... Fold1    1    ibs 0.197   coxph
#> 3 list(trt.... Fold2    2 cindex 0.714   coxph
#> 4 list(trt.... Fold2    2    ibs 0.184   coxph
#> 5 list(trt.... Fold1    1 cindex 0.650   rpart
#> 6 list(trt.... Fold1    1    ibs 0.270   rpart
# }
